The '''Republic Prison Block South''' was a cell block in the southern side of the [[Carbonite Prisoner Storage]] section of the [[Minimum Security Section]], a sector of the [[Belsavis prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]], the [[Crisis Response Unit]] worked to secure the block and prevent the release of the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen prisoners in the block, but [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces overran the cell block.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Prison Block South appears as a subregion of the planet Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
